extras.egress_verbatim: No egress meter on any plan; Drive files served from the portal. Not part of the pricing table.
extras.chaining_verbatim: 5 GB x unlimited free portals, each with unlimited users. 100 portals = 500 GB. WebDAV means a plain `rclone copy` per portal — the most scriptable of the free-workspace KBs.
